name: action-tracker
description: A Kanban-style action board with drag-and-drop, streaks, confetti celebrations, and AI integration. Track real-world action items through TODO, DOING, and DONE columns.
shortDescription: Kanban board with drag-and-drop, streaks, and AI integration.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Kanban board with TODO, DOING, and DONE columns
Confetti celebration when items are done
AI integration — ACTION-Q agent can add, prioritise, and delegate items

kanban.name: Kanban Board
kanban.description: Three-column board (TODO, DOING, DONE) to visualize your action items at a glance.

dragDrop.name: Drag & Drop
dragDrop.description: Move cards between columns with smooth drag-and-drop. Status updates automatically.

streaks.name: Completion Streaks
streaks.description: Track consecutive days of completing items. Build momentum and stay motivated.

confetti.name: Confetti Celebrations
confetti.description: Enjoy a confetti burst every time you complete an action item. Small wins matter.

aiIntegration.name: ACTION-Q Agent
aiIntegration.description: ACTION-Q can add items, check progress, suggest priorities, and delegate tasks to agentic objectives. Works with MCP tools.

dueDates.name: Due Dates
dueDates.description: Set due dates on action items with automatic overdue highlighting and stats.

tier_a.name: Action Tracker
tier_a.board: Full Kanban board with all features

futureFeatures: MCP tools for agent-driven action management
Team boards with shared action items

changes: Due date tracking with overdue alerts
Server-first persistence with localStorage cache fallback
Layout regression fix — main panel + sidebar render reliably
ACTION-Q agent registered as dedicated assistant (was falling back to CommanderQ)
Server-side AEE audit envelope for every tool call
/sync endpoint hardened — server-generated IDs, visibility filter, 500-item cap
Optimistic update rollback on server failure (move/delete/save)
Single-item GET endpoint for direct fetch (avoids 200-item linear scan)
Modal a11y — role=dialog, aria-modal, focus trap, keyboard-activatable rows
